about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: IT professional specialized in cloud solutions on Google Cloud Platform, leading critical migrations and designing scalable, high-availability architectures.
about.paragraph2: I get involved in every project, paying close attention to the details and, above all, to what the client actually needs. I enjoy the teaching side of my work: answering questions and guiding teams so they get the most out of Google Cloud Platform. I'm also interested in AI applied to the cloud and automation.

vibe.title: Vibe Coding
vibe.intro: This website —and other projects on my GitHub— is developed with the help of artificial intelligence, and I say so openly. The value isn't in "generating code", but in directing the tools with technical judgment, defining good requirements and verifying the result.
vibe.workflowIntro: The workflow I used to ship this very website:

steps.name: Prompt-driven orchestration
steps.description: I defined the requirements in natural language: an Astro website, multilingual (CA/EN/ES), light/dark mode, LinkedIn and GitHub links, a professional IT-focused design, accessible and responsive.

steps.name: Specialized agents in a pipeline
steps.description: Several AI agents were orchestrated in sequence: full-stack development → UI/UX design → QA. Each agent specialized in its own task.

steps.name: Verification & human control
steps.description: Clean build (Astro), automated visual testing with Playwright and an accessibility review (AA contrast, semantic HTML). The final decision and validation are human.

steps.name: Continuous deployment on Cloudflare Pages
steps.description: Every push to GitHub builds and publishes the site automatically on Cloudflare Pages, served from its global network with my own domain sserra.dev, enforced HTTPS and security headers defined in the repository itself.

vibe.promptIntro: This is, in essence, the request that gave birth to the website:
vibe.promptText: "I want to create my personal website with Astro to gain more visibility and have a space where I can explain my current career path. On design, make it attractive, professional and IT-focused, pleasant to look at and easy to read. It should be available in Catalan, English and Spanish, with buttons to my LinkedIn and GitHub, and a toggle between light and dark mode."
